case_title: LISA KOSHKARIAN ET AL VS. CASSIDY WALD ET AL

docket_entries.description: THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF KOSHKARIAN, LISA ELLSWORTH, CHELSEA GUILE, THANDI IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT WALD, CASSIDY PATOU, DAVID SHAIN, JACKSON THERE WAS NO BREACH CAUSING MONETARY DAMAGES TO PLAINTIFFS. IN ANY CASE, PLAINTIFF WAIVED THE DEFECT WHEN SHE SAID IT WAS OK TO RETURN THE KEY THE NEXT DAY. EACH PARTY SHALL BEAR THEIR OWN COSTS.
